snippet.title: Orbit Dash: Update 4.0.0 | 3 New Levels and VERSUS Online (THE FABULOUS, CHROMA, SUNSHINE)
snippet.description:
Orbit Dash: update 4.0.0, our biggest update yet. Three new levels, each on its own original track, and VERSUS online.

THE FABULOUS, DEMON: five minutes down eight circles of hell, a demon lord who roars the level's name, and a peak on four rings at once.
CHROMA, INSANE: neon phonk at 130 BPM. The world splits into red, green and blue, freezes before every drop and shatters at the finale.
SUNSHINE, NORMAL: a saxophonist in a sunflower field, a sun shower and a rainbow.
VERSUS online: see open rooms and join in one tap, open your own room to everyone and get a ping when someone joins, up to 8 players on the same beat.

0:00 THE FABULOUS
0:12 CHROMA and SUNSHINE
0:24 VERSUS online

▶ Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lewydo.orbitdash&referrer=utm_source%3Dyoutube%26utm_medium%3Dvideo%26utm_campaign%3Dupdate4_youtube
🍎 App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6824944395?pt=129589688&ct=update4_youtube&mt=8
All music is original, made by Lewydo.
